purpose: Govern repository-wide static red debt together with proof completeness while prioritising engineering effort by execution, semantic, security/test and maintainability value rather than raw score reduction.

G3.meaning: full-red debt below 2000 with hidden-proof debt exposed

P0_EXECUTION.value_basis: runtime failure, invalid binding or execution blocker

P1_SEMANTIC.value_basis: likely defect, ambiguous behaviour or unsafe semantic pattern

P2_MAINTAINABILITY.value_basis: maintainability, dead code or clarity with plausible engineering benefit

P3_STYLE.value_basis: formatting/readability only; keep measured, repair opportunistically or during housekeeping

E999.value_basis: syntax/parser failure; highest-value defect but source-bound and not auto-mutated

promotion_policy.engineering_credit: VALUE_BEARING_OUTCOME_REQUIRED; raw static-count reduction alone earns no engineering credit

coverage_growth.mechanical_only: NON_REGRESSION_REQUIRED; explicit NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed only when no executable semantics change
coverage_growth.semantic_source_change: REQUIRED; add or strengthen test/check evidence or provide measured existing-line coverage proof
coverage_growth.workflow_change: REQUIRED; increase executed-check visibility or classify every intentional skip
coverage_growth.per_batch_control: record before/after coverage evidence and check-surface delta
